title: Refund Threshold and Refund Timing by Billing Class (Patient Invoices & Statements)
content:
Patient Invoices & Statements uses one refund threshold across all six billing classes; the refund time and the treatment of the patient's other invoices differ by class.

| | Self-Pay Patient Invoice | Consumer Test Purchase Invoice | Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice | Out-of-Network Balance Invoice | Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice | Medicaid Copay Invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Refund threshold (USD) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Refund issued within, calendar days of the credit arising | 30 | 10 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Credit first transferred to the patient's other open invoices | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

- **Refund threshold**: credit balances at or above this amount are refunded or transferred; below it they are held.
- **Refund time**: the calendar days after a credit balance arises within which it is refunded.
- **Transferred first**: whether a credit balance is first transferred to the patient's other open invoices before any refund.

## Boundary of the threshold (hypothetical credit balances)

| Credit balance on the invoice | Compared with the 1.00 threshold | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 0.99 | below | held on the invoice |
| 1.00 | at the threshold | refunded or transferred |
| 12.40 | above | refunded or transferred |

The Consumer Test Purchase Invoice is the only class with a 10-day refund time and the only class that shows No for a first transfer to the patient's other open invoices.
